title: Plan OD-7/R1003: a chipset's ITX variant counts as the chipset
body:
Plan for **OD-7**/`R1003`, written by the steward worker the unattended delivery driver dispatched on base `run/web`. Slug `itx-chipset-variant`, `covers: [R1003]`.

ITX boards are named `<chipset>I`, and the matcher's right boundary refuses to match `b850` inside `b850i`. The evidence in `BL-9`: a real 33-minute review of the MSI MPG B850I Edge TI matched `B850` **zero times** — in its title and throughout — so the board was invisible to the corpus every later stage is built from.

A `BL-<n>` is filed alongside; see `docs/BACKLOG.md`.

Opened by the server-side `open-pr` workflow at the driver's request (ESC-50).
